deviations.what: The forward window maps a patent filed in year fy to focal years fy - 0:(forward_years - 1) = fy, fy-1, fy-2, so the window is t to t+2 instead of t+1 to t+3: year t is wrongly counted and year t+3 is dropped (the comment says fy-forward_years .. fy-1, but the code does not do that).

notes: All other rules match the spec: filing-year dating, first-listed code filter, dropping missing classes, the base window t-5..t-1 (line 16), NA when the base is empty, 0 when there are no forward patents, joins kept within each firm, and one row per distinct firm-year with the required columns. A fix for line 18 would be year = fy - seq_len(forward_years).
